title: Administrative authority vocabulary
description: Identifier grammars and closed enumerations of Control Plane administrative authority (ADR-BCP-020). A definition library: validate against the fragments.

administrativeGrantId.description: Control Plane-minted identifier of an AdministrativeGrant.

administrativeDecisionId.description: Control Plane-minted identifier of an AdministrativeDecision.

principalId.description: Canonical Control Plane principal identifier (ADR-BCP-020 section 7). Never an email address, display name, username or an IAM provider's internal user id.

administrativePermissionKey.description: A permission registered in permission-registry.yaml, e.g. tenant.suspend. An administrative action over Control Plane resources, never a product capability key (section 9).

administrativeProfileKey.description: A profile registered in profile-registry.yaml, e.g. tenant-administrator. A policy template, never a grant (section 21).

permissionDomain.description: Policy domain of an administrative permission (section 10).

riskClass.description: Risk classification of an administrative permission (section 40).

scopeLevel.description: The anchor an administrative scope is expressed at (section 11). A permission names the levels it may be granted at.

scopeMode.description: EXACT: the named anchor only. STATIC_MEMBERSHIP: a corporate group's organisations as listed at grant time; later members are not added (section 18). DYNAMIC_GROUP_DESCENDANTS: the group's current descendants, stated explicitly on the grant (section 19). The default is no automatic expansion (section 20).

grantStatus.description: Administrative grant lifecycle (sections 57-62, lifecycle.yaml). Only ACTIVE is eligible for evaluation.

grantType.description: Section 54. TIME_BOUND and JUST_IN_TIME grants carry valid_until.

grantSource.description: How the grant came to exist. PROFILE: expanded from an administrative profile (section 22). DELEGATION: delegated from another grant, which it names (sections 42-48). BOOTSTRAP: the controlled initial platform authority of section 128, never a routine mechanism (section 129).

decisionOutcome.description: Section 97. Anything but ALLOW does not permit the action.

administrativeMetric.description: Administrative authority metrics, exposed in Prometheus form. administrative_authority_shadow_total counts role-guarded administrative requests by how the legacy role decision compared with the AdministrativeGrant decision (ADR-BCP-020 section 144); it never changes a decision.

administrativeMetricLabel.description: The only label names administrative metrics may carry. permission takes a key of permission-registry.yaml or unregistered; legacy, grants and agreement take shadowLegacyOutcome, shadowGrantsOutcome and shadowAgreement values.

shadowGrantsOutcome.description: One value per decisionOutcome (ALLOW allow, DENY deny, STEP_UP_REQUIRED step_up, APPROVAL_REQUIRED approval_required, NOT_READY not_ready), plus three for when no decision was made. unresolved: the caller has no ACTIVE principal. unmapped: the route names no registered permission yet. error: grants could not be read in time. Every value but allow counts as grants not allowing.

shadowAgreement.description: grants_broader: grants would allow what the role check denied, which must never occur before enforcement moves to grants. grants_narrower: grants would deny what the role check allowed.

administrativeReasonCode.description: A code registered in the administrative_denial category of contracts/authorization/v1/reason-code-registry.yaml. Safe to show: it never reveals internal policy detail (section 98).
